```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('readings.csv')

# Extract the temp column values
temp_values = df['temp'].values

# Compute the mean and round to 2 decimal places
mean_temp = np.mean(temp_values).round(2)

# Write the mean to mean.txt
```
